title: Intent Brief
description:
The first artifact of every reasoning path, rendered deterministically from the Stage 2 intent record the moment Stage 2 completes (docs/41 D-66). It exists so a reader has something true to read while the slow stages run (NFR-001, FR-041), and it says what it is: what the input asks for, as understood — NOT a conclusion, a design, or a recommendation. Nothing in it is reasoned; every statement carries the provenance Stage 2 gave it (FR-042/FR-043).

Rendered, not generated (docs/15 D-40): no provider call, no second content model, cannot disagree with the intent record it is a projection of. Published to ARTIFACT_SCHEMA per DB §4.4 and validated like any artifact (FR-039) — a rendering bug is a schema failure.

TOLERANCE. additionalProperties is left open, matching every other published artifact schema and the parsers they pair with (AI §9.3).

objective.description: Stage 2's primary objective, with its provenance.

secondary_objectives.description: May be empty: an input with one aim has one aim.

inferred_scope.description: The boundary Stage 2 drew around the problem.

requested_outcome.description: D-90: what the submitter asked to receive. understanding_only means the input declined a design in its own words (see decline_quote), and no solution artifact follows this brief.

decline_quote.description: D-90: the submitter's verbatim words declining a design, verified against the input at Stage 2; null unless requested_outcome is understanding_only.

standing.description: Fixed by the renderer, never read from a model: this artifact states how the input was understood before any reasoning, and a reader must be able to tell that from the document itself.

provenance.description: FR-042: stated is in the input; inferred was derived from it. Stage 2 admits no unknown objective — an input with no discernible aim halts there.
